title: FAQ accordion with one open answer
prompt: Build a FAQ with four questions. Each question is a button that shows or hides its answer: "What is Orbit?" answers "Orbit is a project tracker.", "Is there a free plan?" answers "Yes, for up to three projects.", "Can I export my data?" answers "Yes, as CSV or JSON.", and "How do I contact support?" answers "Email support@example.com.". All answers start hidden. Each question button reports whether its answer is shown with aria-expanded. Opening one question closes any other open one.
